meta.title: Auto handoff
meta.description: Watches a conversation's context usage and, at a configurable threshold (default 75% of a 150000-token budget = 112500 — NOT 75% of the model's context window), writes a PROJECT_STATE.md handoff into the project directory and opens a new conversation in the same Workspace that continues the task. Default mode is auto: after install it silently monitors in the background and, at the threshold, automatically creates the new conversation and starts it running with a first prompt — no manual action needed. On handoff the old conversation receives a system-level notice to stop working on the task, and a .NOTICE.md file in the project directory records the new session id and document path. Switch between automatic / ask-first / off and tune budgetTokens / thresholdRatio from the Settings → Auto handoff panel, or with the /handoff command (status, auto, confirm, off, budget N, ratio R); changes are written to the user profile override layer and take effect after the plugin reloads. Turning the plugin off stops all checks; it does not delete any handoff document already written. You can choose the model and reasoning effort for the handoff conversation in the "New conversation after handoff" card, or pick them in the dialog at handoff time; /handoff model and /handoff effort also work.
